description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source test management system. It generates a printable HTML view of test case execution details, including rendering headers, execution details, and handling attachments. The script initializes request arguments, manages sessions and external dependencies, and outputs the formatted print content.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Extracts and initializes arguments from the request, such as 'id' and 'deleteAttachmentID', sanitizing inputs for further processing.
